instruction: A perched barn owl built from leaded glass panels, each feather group a separate colored pane held in dark soldered came lines. The heart-shaped face is milky white glass, the wings amber, rust and honey-gold, and the eyes two deep cobalt rounds. Light passes through the body making the panel seams read as black tracery.
